wintun.role: Windows TUN/Wintun-class L3 capture device only; never part of the frozen WBD transport semantics
wintun.integration: Load wintun.dll dynamically and bind only the documented public Wintun API. The deployed DLL/driver must be built or obtained from this pinned source commit, or receive an explicit artifact hash lock before release.
wintun.notes: This pin includes the 2026 missed-wakeup ring-buffer memory-barrier fix. Do not float master during release qualification.

npcap.role: Windows physical packet capture/injection backend for the existing WBD FakeTCP state machine only; it does not define FakeTCP semantics
npcap.integration: Load the system-installed Npcap wpcap.dll dynamically. WBD does not redistribute the Npcap Free Edition. For this personal-use project the operator downloads the pinned public installer directly from npcap.com and completes its normal graphical installation; WBD never invokes OEM-only silent installation and never uploads the installer or extracted DLL as a build artifact.
npcap.qualification: windows-tun-build downloads the pinned public installer directly from npcap.com, verifies SHA-256 and the Nmap Software LLC Authenticode signer, transiently inspects its signed wpcap.dll payload, then deletes it. Product Connect preflights the installed wpcap.dll/Packet.dll/npcap service before Reality admission. The Windows release one-shot still requires an administrator Windows machine with Npcap actually installed and must qualify physical capture/injection plus checksum/LSO/RSC offload interactions.
npcap.notes: Npcap 1.88 is the release-authoritative personal-use development reference. The Free Edition is not redistributed by WBD. Do not silently float the dependency during release qualification.
